name: speaker_word_production
summary: Speaker referring expression production across 2-5 objects and 2-4 features with synonymy.

charter.question: When speakers choose a single word to refer to a highlighted target object in context, do their word choices follow recursive listener simulation, graded lexical precision with extension costs, competitor-confusion avoidance, or singleton heuristics?

instructions.welcome: Welcome! In this short study, you will play a communication game where you describe a highlighted object so a listener can pick it out.
instructions.task: On each turn, you will see a row of objects with one target object highlighted in an orange frame. Choose one word from the buttons below to describe the highlighted target object to a listener who sees the same objects.

comprehension_checks.question: Which object are you describing on each turn?
options: The target object highlighted in an orange frame

comprehension_checks.question: How do you describe the highlighted object?
options: By choosing one of the word buttons that applies to it
